name: Heavy Permafrost Convergence · Water
primary:
A projectile flies in an arc where you look and strikes the first target. Effects:
• Damage 2.25 ❤ lightning + 4.5 ❤ earth (lightning ×2 on wet, earth ×2 on frozen)
• Cold 72: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Charge 63: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)
• Then the lightning jumps onward: up to 8 targets in a row, jumps up to 6 blocks, 2.25 ❤ and 40 charge each (×2 damage and longer jumps on wet, ×1.5 range in puddles)
• Knockback
• Breaks up to 15 blocks within 1.45 blocks (twice as many if brittle)
• Soaked for 12 s and leaves a puddle
self_description:

• Damage 2.25 ❤ lightning (lightning ×2 on wet)
• Cold 72: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Charge 63: weakness, stuns for 1 s at 65 charge (×2 on wet)

• Slowness II for 10.5 s
• Soaked for 6 s and leaves a puddle
